episodes.synopsis: Ninny Spangcole and Noel Niihashi are two Pipers at Wing Bind who secretly help keep the peace in Front London while keeping dragons in check in Reverse London.
episodes.title: Witches Blow a New Pipe

episodes.synopsis: Ninny and Noel try to fight the Märchen that appeared before it destroys all of London.
episodes.title: Ghillie Suit / She Makes Me Special

episodes.synopsis: Bruno Bangnyfe from the Top of Horns wants to eliminate Balgo for being a dragonclad so he can collect the bounty that’s about to be on his head. Ninny’s old groupmate, Macy, appears before her again and is in possession of a dragon.
episodes.title: If a Lion Could Speak, We Couldn't Understand
